checks.name: schema
checks.detail: 1200 records readable; missing recommended fields cell, so some checks below will skip.

checks.name: chance correction
checks.detail: one test-set shape (n=150, p=75); chance AP is 0.5154, which exceeds the base rate 0.5000 by 0.0154. Constant here, so raw AP is comparable WITHIN this file and nowhere else.

checks.name: negative control
checks.detail: 20 splits (80 records): ROC-AUC 0.5058 (+0.66 sigma), normAP +0.0082 (+0.60 sigma).

checks.name: pairing integrity
checks.detail: all 300 (seed, cell) groups share one test-label fingerprint, so paired tests over them are valid.

checks.name: unit of analysis
checks.detail: 1200 records = 15 configurations x ~20 seeds. Across-configuration claims have n=15, not n=1200. State which n any reported p-value rests on.

checks.name: statistical power
checks.detail: median paired sd 0.0841 over 20 seeds gives a minimum detectable effect near 0.0555 in normAP. A null result here excludes effects LARGER than that and nothing smaller. That is coarse relative to effects this literature reports.

checks.name: precision floor
checks.detail: 1 of 90 method pairs differ by less than the declared floor of 0.001. Below it a difference is not reproducible and must be reported as such, not as a measurement.

checks.name: multiplicity
checks.detail: this file supports 90 pairwise comparisons across 15 configurations. Uncorrected, the chance of at least one spurious rejection at alpha 0.05 is about 0.99. Declare which are confirmatory, or correct (Bonferroni would be 5.56e-04).

checks.name: tuning symmetry
checks.detail: methods differ sharply in what they were observed selecting: linear 1 structural / 9 C (no parameters); poly 99 structural / 9 C; quantum-angle-r1 1 structural / 6 C; quantum-angle-r2 1 structural / 8 C; quantum-iqp-r1 1 structural / 7 C; quantum-iqp-r2 1 structural / 7 C; rbf 10 structural / 7 C. quantum-angle-r1 (fixed: embedding, reps); quantum-angle-r2 (fixed: embedding, reps); quantum-iqp-r1 (fixed: embedding, reps); quantum-iqp-r2 (fixed: embedding, reps) record parameters that never varied, so on this evidence those were fixed while other methods searched. If one arm's kernel width is tuned and the other's is fixed, the comparison measures that as much as it measures the kernels. A wide grid with one consistent winner looks identical here and is not the same thing; the records cannot tell them apart. Methods with no parameters at all, such as a linear kernel, are excluded rather than counted as untuned.

checks.name: cross-arm comparison
checks.detail: 300 (seed, configuration) groups pair across the two files on verified matching test points. Across-arm paired sd 0.0921 over 20 seeds per configuration gives a minimum detectable effect near 0.0609. THIS is the power of the comparison being made; the figure above is the power of comparisons within one arm.

checks.name: kernel conditioning
checks.detail: condition number reaches 7.8e+19 over 6 sampled kernels covering 4 method(s) (quantum-angle-r1, quantum-angle-r2, quantum-iqp-r1, quantum-iqp-r2) on 6 seed(s). The dual is underdetermined at that conditioning, so decision scores are reproducible only to a floor you must measure and quote, and threshold-based tests such as McNemar are not usable. Rank statistics survive; check that yours are.

numbers.coverage: 4 method(s) (quantum-angle-r1, quantum-angle-r2, quantum-iqp-r1, quantum-iqp-r2) on 6 seed(s)

checks.name: classical surrogate equivalence
checks.detail: every one of 6 sampled kernels separates from its nearest classical surrogate, median 0.0050 in normAP, range 1.35e-03 to 6.48e-02, all above the 1e-03 floor, covering 4 method(s) (quantum-angle-r1, quantum-angle-r2, quantum-iqp-r1, quantum-iqp-r2) on 6 seed(s). That is the size of what the non-classical structure is worth here, in endpoint units, and it carries no sign about the best classical kernel: a kernel can separate from its surrogate and still lose to it.

numbers.coverage: 4 method(s) (quantum-angle-r1, quantum-angle-r2, quantum-iqp-r1, quantum-iqp-r2) on 6 seed(s)

checks.name: selection
checks.detail: inner scores recorded alongside test scores; their rank correlation is +0.429. Selection auditable.

not_runnable.name: grid adequacy against a shuffled null
not_runnable.reason: needs a re-run, not a hook: the same pipeline on permuted labels with a widened grid. Widening raises the best inner score even when nothing is better, so hyperparameter edge flags never justify it on their own.
